notes:
Topline: Mid-market product analytics company building a conversational product advisor inside their SaaS UI. Evaluated Hosted API over 4-week trial, now moving to Dedicated sizing and pricing conversations.

Trial summary:
- Trial window: 2024-12-01 -> 2024-12-29 (30 days).
- Primary workload: in-app chat + on-demand doc search + recommendations. Chat ~55% of calls, embeddings/doc-search ~30%, reranking/other ~15%.
- Observed traffic (hosted trial): steady-state 18 QPS, weekday peak 65 QPS (spikes around product release emails), avg concurrency seen by app ~24 requests in flight.
- Token mix (observed): 60% short (<256 tokens total), 30% medium (256-1024 tokens), 10% long (>1024 tokens). Average tokens/request ≈ 480 (prompt+completion).
- Latency: p50 generation ~220ms for short responses, p95 ~880ms (longer for >1024 token completions).
- Failures: 0.2% rate during high-peak windows, mainly 5xx transient; Redwood hosted team suggested caching + prefix KV to reduce repeated context cost.
- Quality: model baseline (open model family) acceptable for release candidate; product team flagged 8/50 prompts with hallucination patterns — request for eval hooks + rollout controls.

Dedicated sizing ask (what Aurora Trench expects):
- Target SLOs: 95th latency <1s for short+medium flows; allow async background jobs for long-runner completions.
- Forecasted traffic for Q1 post-launch: avg 35 QPS, peak 120 QPS during marketing-driven spikes. Concurrency planning: sustained concurrency target 50-70, burst capable to 220 for a 10-minute window.
- Token throughput estimate: avg 480 tokens/request × 120 QPS peak => ~57,600 tokens/sec peak. Planning asked for token/s and GPU slot sizing guidance (quantized 8-bit variants acceptable for cost).
- Model mix preference: primary: 13B open model (quantized) for cost-critical paths; fallback: 30B unquantized for higher-quality sessions; embeddings via smaller specialized embedder.
- Routing requirements: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU residency for certain enterprise customers), automatic fallback to cheaper variant if Dedicated pool saturated.

Security / compliance trail:
- Submitted security questionnaire 2024-12-18 (legal + infosec). Needs SOC2 report, SSO/SAML integration, KMS integration for key management, and audit logs retained 1 year. Also asked about data residency for EU customers — need Private or Dedicated with EU region.
- SE demo on 2025-01-07 walked through RBAC, audit log exports, and canary rollout example. Follow-up: provide config examples for canary/AB routing and retention controls.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Pricing sensitivity: mid (wants predictability). Prefers a committed monthly Dedicated commitment with burst credits. Interested in 12-month term with quarterly review.
- ARR expectation tied to feature rollout: initial Dedicated commit request scoped to support 100–120 QPS peak; company wants an option to scale faster if adoption > forecast.
- Internal procurement timeline: finance decision meeting scheduled 2025-02-15; legal review expected complete by 2025-02-28. Forecast close target set to 2025-03.
